tool_input.command:
$form = 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}'
$login12 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/company_base_url}}v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $form -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$login71 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/base_url}}v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $form -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$token12 = [string](($login12.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$token71 = [string](($login71.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$uri12 = '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/company_base_url}}v1/cs/configs?dataId=zhishu-company-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token12)
$uri71 = '{{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/base_url}}v1/cs/configs?dataId=shared-redis-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=suzhou-taicang-wuguan&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token71)
$company = [string](Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri12 -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15).Content
$shared = [string](Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri71 -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15).Content
$ch = [regex]::Match($company, '(?im)^\s*host\s*:\s*([^\s#]+)')
$cp = [regex]::Match($company, '(?im)^\s*port\s*:\s*([^\s#]+)')
$sh = [regex]::Match($shared, '(?im)^\s*host\s*:\s*([^\s#]+)')
$sp = [regex]::Match($shared, '(?im)^\s*port\s*:\s*([^\s#]+)')
'COMPANY_REDIS=' + $ch.Groups[1].Value + ':' + $cp.Groups[1].Value
'SHARED_REDIS=' + $sh.Groups[1].Value + ':' + $sp.Groups[1].Value
'REDIS_ENDPOINTS_MATCH=' + (($ch.Groups[1].Value -eq $sh.Groups[1].Value) -and ($cp.Groups[1].Value -eq $sp.Groups[1].Value))
